title: GitHub Copilot for JetBrains 1.5.60
body_markdown:
* Added: Custom agent – customize your chat mode with your own configurations.
* Added: Isolated subagents – use isolated context of specified agents to make agents more accurate and effective.
* Added: Plan agent – create detailed implementation plans before starting the implementation.
* Added: Dynamic OAuth – flexible authentication for enterprise and cloud environments.
* Added: Auto model selection – automatic model selection within Copilot Chat for optimized performance.
* Added: Support for the GPT-5-Codex model (Preview).
* Added: Global instruction and prompt file support.
* Added: Customize folder path for Workspace instruction and prompt file.
* Added: **Log Models** action and command for easier troubleshooting.
* Added: Continue confirmation UI when max tool calls are reached.
* Added: MCP server management and configuration.
* Added: Support multiple modules projects in agent mode.
* Added: Various UI improvements.
* Fixed: Popup position and focus issues for # context.
* Fixed: **No model found** error when sampling.
* Fixed: Multi-line paste issue in Copilot Chat input panel.
* Fixed: Copilot editing wrong file.
* Fixed: Adjusted input handling for required and optional resource template variables.
